blocks.text: Water is at the heart of your time in Bonito. At Estância Mimosa, trails lead past cascades and natural pools. In the Blue Lake Grotto, a clear underground lake changes colour in the sunlight. The gentle current of the Rio Sucuri carries you past plants and fish, and the water is so clear that you can see the riverbed far ahead. Rafting and a ropes course among the trees follow.

blocks.text: An optional trip to the Anhumas Abyss takes you straight down through a narrow fissure into a vast cavern. At the bottom lies an underground lake, with giant stalactites hanging above the water. With visitor numbers limited and the cave cool and quiet, this part of the trip feels a world away from the bright tropical landscape outside.
